story-context.title: File Upload Component (Full Stack)
story-context.overview: Introduce file-upload end-to-end: builder + runtime + token-scoped public upload API + SubmissionAttachment persistence + bind on submit + company download. Align types with existing DefinitionJSON / form_definition.py patterns from 6.2.1.

constraints.item: Do NOT run Alembic upgrade/downgrade/revision in agent shell; prepare migration file(s) and give Anthony exact commands.
Never commit secrets; storage path from env/config only (same env vars as assets: ASSET_STORAGE_PROVIDER, ASSET_STORAGE_LOCAL_DIR, Azure connection string + container when used).
Attach uploaded files to FormSubmission only after successful submission; never expose raw storage keys or filesystem paths to browser—only public attachment UUIDs.
Use opaque UUID (or similar) as client-facing attachment id; validate ownership on submit.
Do NOT insert anonymous submission uploads into dbo.Asset; Asset is CompanyID + AssetType scoped. SubmissionAttachment is the listing table for all lead/scoped files.

physical-storage.summary: Reuse modules/assets/storage.py — load_storage_config(), get_storage_provider() — same LocalAssetStorageProvider / Azure behavior as background image uploads.
physical-storage.key-prefix: Use a dedicated prefix for blobs (e.g. submissions/{FormPublicLinkID or hash}/{attachmentPublicId}.ext) so backups and lifecycle policies can treat them separately from company/{sha256} asset keys.

file.note: Reference only: SHA-256 dedupe pattern for company assets (lines ~311–343); adapt scoped dedupe for SubmissionAttachment per story §2.4.1, not cross-company.

deduplication.policy: Optional MVP: same FormPublicLink + same client upload context + same Sha256 while FormSubmissionID IS NULL may return existing public attachment id and skip second blob write.
deduplication.anti-patterns: No global dedupe across tokens; no attaching another respondent's pending upload id to your submission.
deduplication.tests: Implement one test documenting chosen behaviour (reuse id vs always new row); keep AC-3 cross-session rejection test.

component-multiplicity.default: allowMultiple defaults to false — one primary file per component unless author enables multi.
component-multiplicity.when-multiple: maxFiles cap; answer shape is array of attachment ids; one SubmissionAttachment row per id.
component-multiplicity.alternatives: Authors may add a second file-upload component instead of allowMultiple for stricter column-style reporting.

file.purpose: Add FILE_UPLOAD = 'file-upload' to ComponentType enum; extend ComponentProps if needed for documented props.
Submission handler: accept attachment references in answers; orchestrate link to FormSubmissionID.
Document/validate answer shapes for file-upload (e.g. array of attachment ids or structured object).
Mount new upload route module if split from router for clarity.
Add 'file-upload' to ComponentType; file-upload props (accept, max size, multiple, maxFiles).
Register file-upload with structure, preview, runtime.
Treat file-upload as input with label+input+validation pattern.
Render file input; call upload API; merge ids into submit payload.
Mark file-upload as implemented; constraints for AI.
SQLAlchemy model SubmissionAttachment: Sha256, StorageProvider, StorageKey, FormPublicLink FK, nullable FormSubmission FK, public UUID, optional session/context columns for scoped dedupe.
Optional: multipart upload + download handlers if cleaner than monolithic router.
Example name—use next revision after current Alembic head.
Integration-style tests: validate definition, upload mock, submit bind, auth download.

reference-patterns.pattern: See existing POST submissions in public_form_router.py; mirror token resolution, link type, idempotency. answers_by_component_id is JSON-serializable dict—keep attachment refs as strings or small objects agreed in schema.
See story-context-6.2.1.xml for registry + structureDefaults + PropertiesPanel patterns (url/rating).

Follow 035_form_submission_table.py style: MSSQL types, dbo schema, explicit FKs and indexes. Index SubmissionAttachment on public id, FormPublicLinkID, FormSubmissionID, Sha256 (partial where useful for dedupe lookup).
Import get_storage_provider / load_storage_config from modules.assets.storage (or thin wrapper in forms module) to write bytes; mirror Asset row fields at attachment layer only (no Asset ORM).

security-checklist.item: Validate token → FormPublicLink → FormID/Version/Correct status for upload and submit.
Reject attachment ids that belong to another FormPublicLink or orphaned row not tied to client context.
Download endpoint: reuse same authorization as lead/submission export APIs.
